notes: Summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS that started on Hosted API; high likelihood to convert to Dedicated for cost predictability and isolation.
POC takeaways: quality OK for reranking and summarization; p95 latency target is 200ms for support flows. We measured p95=180ms with LLM-XL-v3-small in hosted POC under 50 concurrent sessions.

Pricing ask from Verdanta: prefer commit at 300M tokens/mo, burst to 2x sustained for 24-72h windows, overage cap at 1.2x for first 3 months, 1.5x thereafter. They also want a 4-quarter ramp schedule (50% first q, 75% second, 90% third, full run-rate Q4).
Quote from CTO Erlan: 'We need predictable unit economics. If overage is punitive we'll underutilize features.'
Procurement note: internal threshold for ARR spend needs to be under $250k first-year to avoid executive re-approval. Our estimate $180k-$220k depending on commit/discounts.

Technical note from SE Nina: recommend Dedicated with KV-cache enabled, 8-GPU pool, quantized model variant for chat-heavy routes. Suggest Canary rollout with 10% traffic for first 2 weeks to validate latency under load.
